title: Impulsionando visual world
question: The dashboard must feel like one operations product for every physical business. Keep the assigned world, take a fused challenger, play the category straight, or re-roll.

options.label: Painel de Ordens
options.lineage: Brazilian oficina / back-office work-order wall: clipboards, rubber stamps, pegboard, fluorescent light
options.thesis: Everything that needs a human is a clipped work order with a stampable status — never a decorative KPI gallery.
options.viewport: Tool-hook sidebar; today's briefing as the master ticket; attention queue as clipped orders; agent as the apprentice who fills orders but cannot stamp them.
options.risk: If the materials stay greasy or striped, clinics and real-estate offices will reject it. The grammar is tickets and stamps, refined — not a mechanic shop skin.

options.label: App de balcão
options.lineage: Warm consumer app: soft cards, thumb bar, one saturated color only where something can be done
options.thesis: The only bright color on screen is something you can press — prepared AI stays ink until you stamp it.
options.viewport: Single column of cards; persistent bottom bar on small screens; one action color on the next-best order only.
options.case: Wins Brazilian phone familiarity; loses as a whole world because it is the SaaS default the standing exit already offers.
options.risk: Becomes the GitHub starter with warmer padding. Identity disappears.

options.label: Revista Teletexto
options.lineage: Broadcast teletext: 40×24 grid, cyan live figures, REVEAL for hidden answers
options.thesis: Keyed pages and a REVEAL control make AI-prepared work visible as a hidden answer, never as magic.
options.viewport: Header with page 100; cyan live figures; red REVEAL over a prepared action; body in a rigid cell grid.
options.case: Wins honesty of live figures and REVEAL-for-AI; loses because tenant logos, listings, and clinical records cannot live in a mosaic grid.
options.risk: Reads as retro gimmick; fails WCAG and tenant branding if taken literally.

options.label: Visor de atenção
options.lineage: Camcorder viewfinder: corner brackets, zebra on blown highlights, W–T zoom
options.thesis: The overdue thing is the only subject in focus; everything else sits in the letterbox.
options.viewport: Full-bleed Home; brackets snap around the top attention order; zebra on overdue; W overview / T detail in the header.
options.case: Wins focus-on-overdue; fuses poorly because an empty-center HUD cannot carry pipelines, tables, or finance.
options.risk: Looks like a camera toy; operators need to scan many tickets, not one face.

canonCard.label: Play it straight
canonCard.lineage: Shadcn / Next.js admin: slate sidebar, four KPI cards, sparkline, Inter, soft radius
canonCard.thesis: A competent operations dashboard that sits beside Linear, Stripe Dashboard, and every shadcn admin on GitHub.
canonCard.viewport: Dark sidebar, light canvas, four metric cards on top, chart, table. Agent is a chatbot icon in the corner.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the GitHub starter we must restyle. Safe, and therefore invisible.
